### Paul’s Reward
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/pauls-reward
Passage: 1 Corinthians 9:16-18
Points:
- Proclaiming the gospel was an obligation placed on Paul by Christ rather than an elective personal career.
- Because preaching was an assigned duty as Christ's servant, Paul claimed no credit or boasting in the work itself.
- His reward lay in the distinct privilege of offering the gospel message completely free of charge.
- Forgoing financial support and working with his own hands allowed Paul to display weakness so Christ's strength could be magnified.
- Christians who voluntarily surrender their rightful claims for the sake of God's work receive a greater spiritual reward.
